title: Create a Docker Network
scenario: Create an isolated bridge network for containers.

focus.title: Complete the docker_network resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for docker_network.

hints.why: The Docker provider gives a fast local sandbox for learning Terraform's resource lifecycle without cloud credentials.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `resource "docker_network" "this"`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for docker_network. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use local container resources for practice and integration tests, not as a replacement for production orchestration.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `resource "docker_network" "this"`. Use this code shape: name. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.network_name`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
